scope: Local OpenAI-compatible reply models become a first-class route: providers local writes a validated loopback driver, a served pinned Ollama model is detected as the out-of-box default when no gateway key exists, and a named gateway credential keeps Exa web search working under local replies.
motivation: The owner wants replies to work by default on a fast local model instead of requiring a gateway key. The local driver already existed but could not search, had no owner-facing setup path, and no out-of-box detection.

design.config: localConfig gains optional searchCredentialFile and searchDailyBudgetUsd; the daemon loads that owner-only file for search just as it loads a gateway credential for generation.
design.search: Driver.canSearch replaces the kind===gateway check for tool advertisement. Search always runs a gateway-served model id; a local tag never reaches the gateway.
design.cli: providers local [model] [--base-url url] writes an explicit habitat block under the daemon-custody lock with the same read-modify-write race check as setup; the service must be stopped first.
design.default: With no explicit habitat and no gateway key, effectiveHabitat probes the loopback server once at daemon start and selects the pinned qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M only when the server's own model list contains it. The probe is injected in tests; an unadmitted build still runs without replies.
design.ack: The in-progress acknowledgment is now 🤖{ 👀 } (plain 👀 when disclosure is fully cleared). Final replies are unchanged.

independentReview.method: Implementer self-review of the full diff only.
